import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
bmi_colors = {'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Obese': '#e74c3c', 'Normal Weight': '#3498db'}
for bmi in df['BMI Category'].dropna().unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                alpha=0.6, label=bmi, s=50, 
                color=bmi_colors.get(bmi, '#95a5a6'))
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', loc='lower right')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Stress Level Distribution by Sleep Disorder
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
df_disorder = df.copy()
df_disorder['Sleep Disorder'] = df_disorder['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
sns.boxplot(data=df_disorder, x='Sleep Disorder', y='Stress Level', ax=ax2, palette='Set2')
ax2.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Stress Level Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Plot 3: Physical Activity vs Daily Steps colored by Sleep Quality
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Daily Steps'], 
                      c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', 
                      alpha=0.7, s=50, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (min/day)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps\n(colored by Sleep Quality)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 4: Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax4.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=plt.cm.viridis(range(len(occupation_sleep))))
ax4.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# Add value labels on bars
for i, (bar, val) in enumerate(zip(bars, occupation_sleep.values)):
    ax4.text(val + 0.05, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:.1f}h', 
             va='center', ha='left', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
